objective: Screen 24 short-term index-ETF dip-reversion candidates (6 published rules -- D1 IBS-Algotradekit, D2 IBS-Pagonidis raw, D3 Connors R3, D4 Connors RSI(2) classic, D5 Connors 3-Day High/Low, D6 IBS-filtered RSI(2) -- x 2 signal underlyings QQQ/SPY x 2 execution instruments 1x/3x) against the frozen giants-sweep protocol's G1-G5 gates and a trade-level research-admission rule at realistic T1 market-on-close timing, reporting T0 (same-close, unexecutable) and T2 (next-open) as diagnostics only.

parameters.rule_source: Algotradekit IBS Trading Strategy for SPY and NDQ (fmz.com/strategy/484915)
parameters.entry_condition: IBS <= 0.09 and close > EMA(220)
parameters.ibs_formula: IBS_t = (close_t - low_t) / (high_t - low_t), 0.5 if high_t == low_t

timing_variants.T0: official close signal, same-close fill (diagnostic, unexecutable upper bound)
timing_variants.T1: 15:50 ET minute-bar proxy signal (today's close = last minute close at/before 15:50 ET; today's high/low = minute bars 09:30-15:50 ET; indicators use prior official daily closes plus the proxy), MOC fill at the official close of the same session (primary candidate)
timing_variants.T2: official close signal, next-session official-open fill (diagnostic)

parameters.note: Task brief specifies 14 sessions for both QQQ and SPY; the Pine source's own comment gives SPY max_trade_duration=12, not 14. Implemented per the frozen brief (14 for both); divergence disclosed in decision-record.md, not silently corrected. The Pine source measures IBS from the PRIOR completed bar (high[1]/low[1]/close[1]) with process_orders_on_close=false: taken literally its historical backtest fills a full session later than a same-day-IBS/next-open reading, because the [1]-referenced IBS is already fully known the instant the next bar opens (a live-alert non-repainting idiom). This engine measures IBS from the SAME bar whose close is being decided (Pagonidis's and the other five rules' convention) for T0/T1/T2.

data_v1_sip_daily_and_minute_dip_reversi.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count; for 2023 minute data read only the per-month layout (the legacy whole-year layout overlaps it)
data_v1_sip_daily_and_minute_dip_reversi.source: alpaca SIP daily and minute archive, fully adjusted closes
data_v1_sip_daily_and_minute_dip_reversi.timezone_handling: convert minute timestamps to America/New_York with a proper timezone-aware conversion; never union fixed-offset EDT/EST bands

feature_v1_ibs_rsi_ema_sma_dip_reversion.ibs: IBS_t = (close_t - low_t) / (high_t - low_t), 0.5 if high_t == low_t; T0/T2 from the official daily bar, T1 from the 15:50 ET proxy bar (prior official closes plus the proxy)
feature_v1_ibs_rsi_ema_sma_dip_reversion.wilder_rsi: same recursive definition as scripts/run_giants_sweep.py::_wilder_rsi and scripts/run_h20260922_04_rsi_branch.py::wilder_rsi; T1 proxy applies one extra recursive step from the prior session's official avg-gain/avg-loss state using the proxy close
feature_v1_ibs_rsi_ema_sma_dip_reversion.ema_sma: standard EMA/SMA on official daily closes for T0/T2; T1 applies one extra EMA step (or a rolling window with the last slot replaced) from the prior session's official state using the proxy close
feature_v1_ibs_rsi_ema_sma_dip_reversion.t1_proxy: today's close = last minute bar close at/before 15:50 ET; today's high/low = max/min of minute bars 09:30-15:50 ET; all indicators otherwise use prior official daily closes

label_v1_t0_t1_t2_trade_return.definition: per-trade net return from entry fill to exit fill, and daily portfolio return series for Sharpe/CAGR/drawdown, computed separately for T0 (signal and fill both at the official close), T1 (signal from the 15:50 ET proxy, fill at the official close of the same session), and T2 (signal at the official close, fill at the next session's official open)

validation_v1_giants_sweep_windows_g1_g5.gates: G1-G5 reused unchanged from scripts/run_giants_sweep.py (G1 anchor CAGR>=50% and max DD>=-35%; G1' anchor Sharpe>=2.0 and CAGR>=30%; G2 holdout Sharpe>=1.0 and holdout CAGR>0; G3 every declared placebo beats the true cell on select Sharpe <=10% of seeds; G4 G1 or G1' still holds at 20bp; G5 long-only spot US ETFs on the existing Alpaca daily cron)
validation_v1_giants_sweep_windows_g1_g5.research_admission_1x_t1_only: mean net return per trade > 0 in both select and holdout; trade-level t>=2.0 over select+holdout; real mean-per-trade >= 95th percentile of the random-entry placebo over select+holdout; T1 keeps >=60% of T0's gross mean per trade
validation_v1_giants_sweep_windows_g1_g5.persistence_table_context_only: 2016-2026 per calendar year, daily T0/T2 only, QQQ/SPY/IWM/DIA, 10bp -- context, not an admission criterion
